issue.title: Concurrent research agents can choose the same shared report output path
issue.description: Discovered while completing sase-ly. The repo-open cleanup bug is separate, but the original incident also exposed a research workflow race: research.0i launched two agents with the same prompt, both were told to write under the shared research repo month directory, and both chose the same report filename (supergrok_subscription_tiers.md). One agent's file was lost through the repo-open cleanup tracked by sase-ly, but after repo open is non-destructive the remaining defect is still real: two concurrent research agents can write, overwrite, or contend for one shared report path with no per-agent uniqueness guarantee. Scope: update the research prompt/template/workflow so parallel research agents use per-agent filenames/directories or another deterministic uniqueness/conflict policy, and add the narrowest regression or workflow check available for concurrent dispatch.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ly — same research.0i incident exposed this independent output-path race; repo-open cleanup destroyed one file, but even after non-destructive opens the shared research month directory still allows parallel agents to choose the same report filename.
